themes.theme: Policy Objectives and Rationale for Reform
themes.reason: Establishes the problem (outdated test driving chemical use) and the explicit objectives the intervention must meet; without this the case for why any new regulation is needed collapses.

Lays out the alternatives considered (do nothing, revoke regulations, update regulations) and justifies selecting 'update the regulations' as the preferred option; this comparative justification is essential to the proposal argument.

themes.theme: The New Match Test and Technical Design
themes.reason: Describes the actual technical content of the chosen intervention (the new match test design) which is the central mechanism by which the policy objectives are to be achieved.

Provides detail on a complementary regulatory change bundled with the proposal, but the core rationale and design of the intervention stand independently via the match test and options appraisal themes.
Describes procedural history and stakeholder reactions that led to revisions, but is background/process detail rather than the substantive justification for the chosen intervention.
Provides detailed quantified cost estimates supporting the should-explain point on costs, but the proposal's rationale does not depend on these specific figures standing or falling.

themes.theme: Benefits and Cost Savings from Reduced Flame Retardant Use
themes.reason: Offers quantified benefit estimates that support but are not essential to the core justification for choosing the new test design over alternatives.

themes.theme: Impact on Small and Medium Enterprises
themes.reason: A narrower distributional consideration about SME costs that elaborates on cost impacts but is not central to the overall proposal rationale.

themes.theme: Scope of Regulations and Compliance Routes
themes.reason: Details secondary design choices (interliners, baby products exclusion) that refine the proposal but are not the main pillars of the argument for the chosen intervention.

themes.theme: Methodology for Estimating Fabric and Flame Retardant Usage
themes.reason: Technical appendix-style detail on how fabric/FR usage figures were derived; it underpins cost/benefit estimates but is not core to the justification of the chosen policy intervention itself.
